name: harmonyos-ui-toolkit
description: HarmonyOS UI development tools for previewing, inspecting, and interacting with ArkUI pages across device sizes.
shortDescription: Tools for HarmonyOS UI preview, inspection, and interaction
longDescription: A toolkit for developing and verifying HarmonyOS user interfaces. Currently includes live ArkUI browser preview with automatic rebuilds, multiple device sizes, runtime resizing, screenshots, component-tree inspection, and interaction controls. Requires a local HarmonyOS toolchain.
defaultPrompt: Preview this ArkUI page live in the browser.
Compare this HarmonyOS page on phone and tablet sizes.
Capture this ArkUI page and verify its component tree.
